name: x-bookmark-manager
description: Turn your X (Twitter) bookmarks into a private, searchable knowledge base with two-way sync — Cloudflare Workers or Docker

scripts.test: node scripts/auth-test.mjs && node scripts/core-test.mjs && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs
scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

SITE_PASSWORD.description: 网站访问密码（用户名任意）。Password for the site; any username works.

X_CLIENT_ID.description: X 开发者后台 App 的 OAuth 2.0 Client ID（[console.x.com](https://console.x.com)）。

X_CLIENT_SECRET.description: X App 的 OAuth 2.0 Client Secret。

LLM_BASE_URL.description: 模型接口地址：OpenAI 兼容填到 `/v1`（如 `https://api.openai.com/v1`），Anthropic 兼容填根地址。
